quote: GPT-5.4 Thinking and GPT-5.4 Pro were released on March 5, 2026, with neither being available to free-tier users.
kind_note: shipped model: paid-tier performance variant of GPT-5.4, released alongside GPT-5.4 Thinking
note: Lab confirmed as OpenAI. The kind hint 'tier' only partly fits: the Pro variant is dated directly in the sources, same day as the GPT-5.4 base model, so the date is not inherited from the base. Public availability is limited to paid plans (not free tier); search snippets from OpenAI's Academy page (not opened) say Pro and Enterprise users plus API and Codex access. TechCrunch (opened: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/05/openai-launches-gpt-5-4-with-pro-and-Thinking-versions/) confirms GPT-5.4 launched March 5, 2026 with Pro and Thinking versions, but does not date Pro separately. OpenAI's own launch post was not located, so the date rests on Wikipedia and TechCrunch rather than the lab's primary release post.
